full_page.content:
Page 152 Cont.
June 18 Baby Michael McNulty - 18 mo. - normal till 15 mo. old. Brain fever came then - sort of sleeping - sickness was Enrolled two months ago and has improved ever since. . . Mother to receive Ist Holy Communion soon.
Rev. Stan. Sosnowski - 70 - very poorly - St. Joseph's Retreat.
19 Mrs. Mary Wilson - 39 - of Ferndale - diabetis - has husband and five children - 2nd eldest studying for an Order ....
20 John M Cay - 33 - mentaly unbalan. and in hospital (now Ford) last 4 mo. Father not to sacraments for having married a lutheran. En- rolled son To-day (5.) and goes to confession.
Harold Martin - wounds in battle James Wykes - missing in action.
Page 153 June 22 Miss Mary Powers - 60 -Sister of Br. Rufin. Serious heart-trouble - Chief Clerk in special Dept. of U. Minn.
Julia Bazz - 24 - working with an atheist ... losing her faith - Mother anxious - enrolled 1.00 Wm A Lynch - 56 - 2nd stroke June 18 - in bad shape ....
Raymond Cameran - 3 - blind in one eye.
26 Bertina Boucher - 18 - graduate in H.S. recently - coming home with girl friend - her partner killed and she badly broken pelvis and skull injuries.
27 Thanks. Harold McGillivray - 7 - operation for apendicitis - three operations - and for 17 months draining. Dr's figuering of 4th opera- tion - the boy was brought to Monastery and enrolled in Ser. Masses - Two days later draining stopped for good. Mother promised ..... five years ago. Boy is in perfect health since.
28 Marion Caradona - 19 - sneezing five days .... parents admonished to make their"Easter" - Enrolled again .... Aug. 3 - is here in perfect health. Says Drs. had given her 24 hrs. to live. Parents made .... Easter.
